_comment: Tool contracts per agent role. This file is data, not prose, so the gate does not depend on an agent reading a standards document correctly at runtime. docs/standards/harness-standard.md explains each role; this file is what CI enforces.

orchestrator.purpose: Runs the pipeline and routes between stages. Broad access by nature.

author.purpose: Writes specs, plans, or code. Needs read and write.

reviewer.purpose: Assesses an artifact and returns a verdict. Must not be able to change what it judges.

verifier.purpose: Tests observable behaviour against declared scenarios. Must not be able to read the implementation it is judging - a verifier that can see the code it grades is the configuration that self-scores high while real behaviour degrades.
verifier.residual_risk: Bash is not forbidden, because the verifier needs it to start a dev server. Bash can read source. This is a declared, accepted hole - closing it properly needs QA to run where sources are not present. See harness-standard.md.
